title: Matt Pocock's skills: the agent skills a real engineer actually uses every day

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Most clawed code prompts are kitchen sync files that give the AI too much room to overthink. Matt PCO's skills repo is the opposite. Small, sharp, single-purpose primitives for TDD, GitHub triage, and breaking architecture into vertical slices. Controlled vocabulary via language.mmd that defines exact architectural terms with strict warnings preventing synonym substitution forces the AI to act like a precision tool, not a rambling chatbot.
